methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched June 2026 from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch. Vimeo's pricing page (vimeo.com/plans, /upgrade, /upgrade-plan) rendered JS-only with no content returned; prices sourced from GetApp aggregator (getapp.com) and corroborated by a second GetApp listing — noted in each plan's provenance. Wistia's official page shows only annual billing price; 20% annual discount stated on page, so month-to-month is not published. Brightcove and Kaltura returned 404 on all pricing URL attempts and publish no self-serve pricing per SoftwareAdvice. Dacast shows annual-only rates; month-to-month exists (3-month minimum) but amounts not disclosed on the pricing page. Loom annual rate computed as 17% off stated monthly rate (per official page claim) but exact annual figure not displayed; month-to-month rates used as monthlyUsd with discount noted. SproutVideo pricing page loaded fully with no annual toggle found. Vidyard Starter price sourced from GetApp/SoftwareAdvice aggregators as official page returned no dollar amounts. All plans with contact-only pricing have monthlyUsd=null.

vendors.name: Wistia
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page wistia.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Page renders plan names and annual billing prices; monthly billing toggle present but month-to-month rate not displayed on page (only annual rate shown). 20% annual discount stated on page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 25 GB storage, 200 GB bandwidth, 1 user. No credit card required.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $79/month billed annually. Month-to-month rate not published on pricing page (implied ~$99/mo based on 20% discount). 3 users included, additional seats at $25/user/mo. 250 GB storage, 1 TB bandwidth. Automation Suite add-on available at $250/mo (annual).

plans.name: Enterprise

vendors.name: SproutVideo

plans.name: Seed

plans.name: Sprout

plans.name: Tree
plans.notes: 1 TB storage, 1 TB bandwidth. Overage at $0.08/GB. Dynamic watermarks, advanced site customization, account audit logs. 150 live input minutes/mo included. Listed as Best Value.

plans.name: Forest
plans.notes: 2 TB storage, 2 TB bandwidth. Overage at $0.06/GB. SSO authentication, geo/IP restrictions, detailed exportable reports, dedicated phone support. 480 live input minutes/mo included.

vendors.name: Brightcove

vendors.name: Dacast

plans.name: Starter

plans.notes: $63/month billed annually. Month-to-month rate not published. 250 GB storage, 6 TB upfront bandwidth. Adds live stream monitoring, China Live, Multi-CDN, paywall, advertising. Overage: $0.30/GB data, $0.15/GB storage.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: $165/month billed annually. Month-to-month rate not published. 2,000 GB storage, 24 TB/year bandwidth. Unlimited channels, DRM for VOD, 3 team members, phone support. Overage: $0.30/GB data, $0.15/GB storage. Additional team seats at $10/mo each.

plans.name: Custom

plans.name: Teams

vendors.name: Loom

plans.name: Starter

plans.name: Business

plans.name: Enterprise
